body:
> This is the naming used in OpenXR (e.g. `xrUnpersistSpatialEntityAsyncEXT`) but I agree it feels wrong.

I think "unpersist" is a word, though. You can unpersist something, ie removing its persistent property.

And something can be "not persistent" (to constrast it from persistent things). There is also "non-persistent" which means temporary (or, actually, more temporary than normal, because otherwise you wouldn't say anything if it was just normal). But I've never personally heard of something being "unpersistent"

This applies to our other buffer getter functions as well.

Before I introduce a bug, when adding them into a single bind, does the order still need to be reversed?

*edit*, yup, they need to be in normal order, not reversed, all good.
Rofl, this used to do more:) Indeed no longer needed.
